draft_en.subject: DIN-rail industrial switches - 5-port and 8+2 SFP
draft_en.body:
Hello,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 21 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the industrial switches you supply, neutral-brand DIN-rail units, -40 to 75 C, CE/RoHS, from single units: 8 x Gigabit + 2 x SFP unmanaged, 12-58 V DC - model STI-280GE - $46 USD EXW (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 5 x Gigabit - STI-050GE - $17.0; the 8 + 2 SFP L2 managed version, Marvell-based - STI-280GM - $68.2.

One question: which configuration do your customers order most - plain 5-port, 8 + 2 SFP, or managed?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
